verdict.rationale: Docs say self-hosted Skyvern runs with "your own LLM keys" / "your LLM API keys", and a community user reports paying their own OpenAI API bill, so bring-your-own-key is supported in self-hosted mode. The evidence never names which providers or models are supported, so model-agnosticism across vendors is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported LLM providers and models, documentation on configuring or switching providers, evidence that BYO-LLM works in the cloud offering, and hands-on corroboration with non-OpenAI models.
